","^Bigger than anyone here thinks. Bowl folk will tell you it was all orchards, and that's rubbish. There were highways, power lines, towns bigger than Nose and Bowl put together. The orchards were only what you could see from the canals. I knew men of the <term=old_army>Old Army</term> who could drive a mountain road blind, and there's nobody like them left.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Good people, slow talkers. They'd hold a meeting to decide whether to hold a meeting. Still, their grain keeps us fed, so the Army minds its manners with them.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Scavengers gab about the Burnt Convoy now and then, that row of burnt trucks the road crews hauled off. Picked clean, they say. The stretch is all ash and bent rims, and not worth the fuel to go and look.","
","ev","str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Nobody knows, but I'd wager she moves it. Her signal's strongest at night, and it drifts like the mast is on wheels. Don't tell the Sergeant I listen to her. He thinks this shack is for the Army alone.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_jj","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Some say it counts the years since the fall. A tone's a tone, though. I've listened a long while and I hear a tone. If it counts, it counts without me.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They carry the mail between the towns. They run in pairs now, one to drive and one to hold the gun. I remember when they went out alone, before the Kiln riders got bold. Kiln's the raider camp in the south. Tamsin Roe's the odd one, with no gun at all. I hear her call-sign more than any other.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_couriers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A whole convoy went up in one night, years back. Some say raiders did it. Some say a fuel truck blew and took the rest with it. I heard the last calls on the air, and nobody said who started it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Hungry. Commander Lind nailed a book of every unpaid promise to the gate at Old Orchard, the Army's depot, and then he died in the motor pool. I heard his last calls on the air. He read the whole list. The machine tools stayed behind in the shed, and somebody's still paying for those.","
","^Some say the Army didn't run out of food. They say it was starved on purpose. I say a man who starts a rumor like that wants a seat in the hall.","
","ev","str","^talkArmyStarved","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^The Guild's trust owns them and rents them to us. Command pays the Guild, and the Guild hears who pays command. I hear the Guild on the air, a little. I won't repeat it.","
","ev","str","^talkCommitteeRent","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Vance! He sat at my table on cold nights, and I'd have trusted him with my radio. You never know a man until he sells you out.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Pell? That man can't steal a biscuit without saying sorry to it. Somebody else is laughing tonight.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The depot's clean, they say. Funny, then, that the trader by the gate still sells fuel cheap.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Fuel still goes missing, they say. It's not my business, and it's not yours either, now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^А? Садись на ящик. Я Ибо. Слушаю эфир для Армии, а всё остальное для себя.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Чем ты тут в будке занят?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Каким был старый мир?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_oldworld"},{"VAR?":"asked_oldworld"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь о чашниках?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_bowl"},{"VAR?":"asked_bowl"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что интересного слышно в эфире?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Откуда вещает Джилл Джейн?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_jj"},{"VAR?":"asked_jj"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что говорит тон из корпуса?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tone"},{"VAR?":"asked_tone"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто такие курьеры Гильдии?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_couriers"},{"VAR?":"asked_couriers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что случилось на Сгоревшем конвое?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_convoy"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_convoy"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Как кончилась Старая армия?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_army"},{"VAR?":"asked_army"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Кто платит за станки Старого сада?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_tools"},{"VAR?":"asked_tools"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Слышал про дела в депо?","/str",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"str","^open","/str","!=","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^До свидания.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^В основном мёрзну и слушаю. Армия платит мне за то, что я слушаю её переговоры, а всё остальное, что поймаю, оставляю при себе. Есть Джилл Джейн, у неё «Радио Трата времени», лучше всего ловится после наступления темноты. Есть курьеры <term=guild>Гильдии</term>, они выходят на связь в пути. А иногда из большого корпуса идёт тон, который никто не объяснит. Сам приёмник работы <term=old_world>старого мира</term>, ещё с тех пор, когда мачты стояли на каждом холме. Работа холодная, зато тихая, и большего мне никогда не хотелось.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_jj","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_couriers","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Больше, чем тут думают. Чашники скажут, что там были одни сады, и это чепуха. Были шоссе, линии электропередачи, города больше Носа и Чаши вместе взятых. Сады — это только то, что было видно с каналов. Я знал людей из <term=old_army>Старой армии</term>, которые могли вести машину по горной дороге вслепую. Таких больше нет.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Люди хорошие, говорят медленно. Соберут сход решать, собирать ли сход. Зато их зерно нас кормит, так что Армия с ними ведёт себя вежливо.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_bowl","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Мусорщики иногда болтают про Сгоревший конвой, тот ряд обгорелых грузовиков, что дорожные бригады оттащили. Говорят, всё подчистую растащили. Там сплошной пепел и гнутые диски, зря только топливо потратишь, если поедешь смотреть.","
","ev","str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Никто не знает, но я бы поставил на то, что она возит радиостанцию с собой. Сигнал сильнее всего ночью и плывёт, будто мачта на колёсах. Сержанту не говори, что я её слушаю. Он думает, что эта будка только для Армии.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_jj","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Одни говорят, что считает годы с падения. Но тон — это тон. Я слушаю давно и слышу тон. Если считает, то считает без меня.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tone","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Возят почту между городами. Теперь ездят парами: один ведёт, другой держит оружие. Помню, как они ходили поодиночке, пока рейдеры Обжига не обнаглели. Обжиг — это лагерь рейдеров на юге. Тэмсин Роу не как все, у неё вообще нет огнестрельного оружия. Её позывной я слышу чаще любого другого.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_couriers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Целый конвой сгорел за одну ночь, много лет назад. Одни говорят, рейдеры. Другие говорят, взорвался грузовик с топливом, а от него сгорел весь остальной конвой. Последние вызовы я слышал в эфире, и никто не сказал, кто начал.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_convoy","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Голодом. Командир Линд прибил к воротам Старого сада, армейского депо, книгу всех невыполненных обещаний, а потом умер в автопарке. Его последние вызовы я слышал в эфире. Он прочёл весь список. Станки остались в сарае, и за них до сих пор кто-то платит.","
","^Одни говорят, что у Армии не кончилась еда. Говорят, её уморили нарочно. Я скажу так: кто запускает такой слух, тот хочет место в зале.","
","ev","str","^talkArmyStarved","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_army","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Станками владеет трастовый фонд Гильдии, он и сдаёт их нам в аренду. Штаб платит Гильдии, а Гильдия слышит, кто платит штабу. Кое-что из переговоров Гильдии я слышу в эфире. Пересказывать не буду.","
","ev","str","^talkCommitteeRent","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_tools","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"depot_thief"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^vance","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Вэнс! Сидел за моим столом холодными ночами, и я доверил бы ему приёмник. Человека не узнаешь, пока он тебя не продаст.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^pell","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Пелл? Этот не украдёт и печенья, не попросив у него прощения. Этой ночью смеётся кто-то другой.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bought","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^Говорят, в депо чисто. Забавно, что торговец у ворот всё равно продаёт топливо дёшево.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Говорят, топливо всё ещё пропадает. Не моё дело, а теперь и не твоё.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_oldworld"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_bowl"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_jj"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tone"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_couriers"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_convoy"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_army"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_army"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_tools"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_tools"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

","^Nose. The dispatch desk is mine. Freight on the north-east road or through the canyon crossing passes this desk, or it doesn't pass. If you want something to be proud of, ask the <term=committee>Committee</term> about the workshop line. It builds whole engines and guns. Bowl can't.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^On paper the Central Committee. In the street the Army. Command gives me orders, I hand them down, nobody argues. I hear <term=bowl>Bowl</term> votes on everything. I wouldn't last a morning there.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Bad once you're past the walls. Nobody keeps the road between our wall and Bowl's. Kiln riders, the raiders from the camp in the south, strip any truck that won't pay or fight. I log every truck out and every truck in. The ones that don't come back are the part I like least. That's why no truck gets out without a gun. That's the gate law. One courier goes without. I haven't decided what I think of her.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["

","^Him. He sold us our own radio back, and I paid stock price for it. That set came off wagon Seven. She ran water drums from the Pump Station down to Bowl every week, and she went dark on the bend in the Bowl north road. The crew walked in and reported raiders, and her cannon lost over the edge. Command wrote her off. I log it.","
","^The scavenger said for a little more that the cannon's still on her. I didn't pay a little more.","

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["

",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Teller drives the water cart now. His stripes are in my drawer. A pair of depot trucks with the same one-pin mount are off the road until Lena has looked at them. Command hasn't answered. I log that too.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^The raid report and the stub share a page, and command reads the top of it. A pair of depot trucks with the same one-pin mount are off the road until Lena has looked at them. That's as far as my sheet goes.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Corporal Teller came back from the wash pit with wet hands and a light wallet. I don't log what I don't see, and I didn't see anything.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Soldiers buy water at Bowl, and Bowl talks over the cups. Now my men come back up the road asking whether their own pins will hold. You told Bowl before you told my log. I won't forget the order you did it in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^A piece of Army steel from wagon Seven changed hands at the <term=salvage_yard>Yard</term>. I logged the sale. Your name is on the line, beside the price.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Old Orchard, the Old Army's depot. The machine tools are the Guild's, and command rents them. Who pays that rent is above my sheet.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^No gun, no gate pass. The line hands every driver a steel mount with his pass, so nobody can tell me he had nothing to bolt on. What happens to the mount after that is between the driver and <term=pierce>Pierce</term>. Pierce writes his paper. I don't ask.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^Tamsin Roe, of the Guild. The Guild carries the mail between the towns. She drives with no gun of her own. The courier who runs with her carries the rifle. A pair gets through my gate, but I don't like what it teaches the other drivers. Brave or stupid, I haven't decided.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^It's the insurance that pays a driver when his truck is shot. Pierce won't write it for a mount with one pin. Command ordered one pin. What a driver does about that, I don't log.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_gate_law"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_paper"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_paper"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",{"->":"start.9"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Сержант Ковач, диспетчерская. Говори по делу, коротко. График сам не заполнится.","

«Пирс»?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_paper"},{"VAR?":"asked_paper"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-15","flg":5},"ev","str","^До свидания.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-16","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Нос. Диспетчерская моя. Без меня ни один груз не пройдёт ни по северо-восточной дороге, ни через переправу в каньоне. Хочешь увидеть, чем можно гордиться, спроси <term=committee>Комитет</term> про мастерскую. Там собирают двигатели целиком и пушки. Чаше такое не под силу.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^На бумаге Центральный комитет. На улице армия. Командование отдаёт мне приказы, я передаю их подчинённым, никто не спорит. Слышал, <term=bowl>Чаша</term> голосует по каждому поводу. Я бы там и утра не продержался.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^За стенами плохая. Дорогу между нашей стеной и стеной Чаши никто не держит. Обжиговцы, рейдеры из южного лагеря, раздевают любой грузовик, который не платит и не дерётся. Я записываю каждый грузовик на выезде и на въезде. Хуже всего, когда грузовик не возвращается. Поэтому без пушки грузовик не выпускаю. Это закон ворот. Одна курьерша ездит без неё. Что о ней думать, пока не решил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
",["ev",{"x()":"board_full"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^По журналу у тебя уже предел заказов. Сперва закрой текущие.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!",{"x()":"has_offers"},"&&","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Подходящего тебе на доске сейчас нет.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Доска сегодня пуста. Завтра заходи.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],"nop","
","^На доске есть вот это. Берёшь? ","#","^work_offer","/#","
",["ev","str","^Да.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Нет.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"x()":"take_work"},"pop","/ev","
","^Записано. Не опаздывай.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-4":["
","ev","str","^nose_depot_leak","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-5":["
","ev","str","^nose_depot_leak","/str",{"x()":"begin","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","end",null],"c-6":["
","^Он. Продал нам нашу же рацию, и я заплатил обычную цену. Этот аппарат снят с фургона «Седьмой». Он каждую неделю возил бочки с водой с Насосной станции в Чашу и перестал выходить на связь на повороте дороги к северу от Чаши. Экипаж дошёл пешком и доложил о нападении рейдеров и потере пушки за краем обрыва. Командование списало фургон. Я записал.","
","^Мусорщик предлагал за небольшую доплату рассказать про пушку: мол, она всё ещё на фургоне. Доплачивать я не стал.","
","ev","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Списан приказом, значит, что на нём осталось, твоё. Только не бери в привычку растаскивать армейское имущество.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Что это ты вертишь в руке? Мне не показывай. Покажи Лене у верстака. То, что увижу там, я запишу.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
","ev","str","^wagonFound","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Теллер теперь водит водовозную тележку. Нашивки у меня в ящике. Два складских грузовика с таким же креплением на одном штифте стоят до осмотра Лены. Командование не ответило. Это я тоже записываю.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Рапорт о налёте и огрызок записаны на одной странице, и командование читает только верх. Два складских грузовика с таким же креплением на одном штифте стоят до осмотра Лены. На этом мои полномочия кончаются.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Капрал Теллер вернулся с мойки с мокрыми руками и лёгким кошельком. Чего не вижу, того не записываю, а я ничего не видел.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Солдаты покупают воду в Чаше, а Чаша болтает за чашками. Теперь мои люди возвращаются по дороге и спрашивают, выдержат ли их штифты. От тебя Чаша узнала всё раньше, чем появилась запись в моём журнале. Этого порядка я не забуду.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Кусок армейской стали с фургона «Седьмой» сменил хозяина на <term=salvage_yard>Свалке</term>. Я записал продажу. Твоё имя в строке, рядом с ценой.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Старый сад, склад Старой армии. Станки принадлежат Гильдии, командование их арендует. Кто платит за аренду — вопрос не ко мне.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^Нет пушки, нет пропуска. Мастерская выдаёт каждому водителю стальное крепление вместе с пропуском, так что никто не скажет мне, что ему не на что было ставить пушку. Что станет с креплением дальше — дело водителя и <term=pierce>«Пирса»</term>. «Пирс» оформляет страховку. Я не спрашиваю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^Тэмсин Роу, из Гильдии. Гильдия возит почту между городами. Своей пушки у неё нет. Курьер, что ходит с ней, несёт винтовку. Пара через мои ворота проходит, но мне не нравится, чему это учит других водителей. Храбрость или глупость, я не решил.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^По этой страховке водитель получает деньги, если его грузовик повредили выстрелами. Крепление с одним штифтом «Пирс» не страхует. А командование приказало ставить один штифт. Что водитель делает по этому поводу, я не записываю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_workshop"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_gate_law"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_courier"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_paper"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_paper"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^buried","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You. Teller drinks better this week. Put it on the bench or don't, I've got work.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^logged","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You again. The page is still in Kovac's log. Command hasn't read it. If it's broken, put it on the bench.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^admitted","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^You again. Teller signed it himself, and a pair of trucks are off the line. Nobody asked me, but that's new. Put it on the bench.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^Lena. If it's broken, put it on the bench. If it's talk, make it quick. My hands are busy.","
",{"->":"start.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any advice for my truck?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where do I find cheap parts?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get clean water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why look at the pins?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_pins"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you trust Brann's mounts?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Kiln riders?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is there anything for the glare?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^I brought something from wagon Seven.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I keep the Army's trucks running. Anybody else's too, if they bring them to my bench. Engines, plate, mounts, whatever breaks. I can tell what's wrong with a truck by the sound of it pulling in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every part does one job and fails at another. Heavy plate stops rounds, but it eats your speed. A big gun eats your deck on top of that. So buy what the road needs, not what shines on the shelf. And if you've got a gun on a swivel, look at the pins first. The swivel's the ring that swings the gun across your bed.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Salvage Yard, a way south of here. The crews strip whatever gets towed in, so parts go for next to nothing. You'll have to put up with the smell of burnt oil. For real plate you want the Fallen Sun, the big hull in the crater. I say that through my teeth.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Green Pit, out past the road. It's a pump outpost round an old cistern, and they pull the water up from deep rock and sell it by the can. It's clean, and it isn't cheap. Bring coin.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Because the copy they bolt on at the gate has one. I've seen what one does on a hard bend. The mount slides and the gun swings round into your own cab. Otto Brann made the first swivel. He gave his a second pin. He was right, and I told command so. Nobody asks a mechanic.","
","ev","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pins","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The ones with his mark, yes. He signs every weld. A weld you can read is a weld you can trust. I've even seen <term=kiln>Kiln</term> riders running captured ones on their own trucks. Good steel doesn't care who owns it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They're raiders from the camp in the south, and I'd sooner not fix a truck they've stripped. But the old woman who keeps their furnace, Dagny Brask, melts captured guns into tools. I own a few. They're decent. Don't tell command I said so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Best metal I ever put a torch to, and the worst place to fetch it. The brass call that hull a warship. I'd like them to show me one gun mount on it. There isn't one. It's cargo holds, all of it. And the glare off the glass around it will blind you by noon.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Lenses cut from the fused glass, dark as smoke. I wear an old pair on bad days. I don't know who sells them now.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["

","end",null],"c-10":["

","^Лена. Сломано, клади на верстак. Разговор, давай покороче. Руки заняты.","

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Чем ты тут занимаешься?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что посоветуешь для моего грузовика?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять дешёвые запчасти?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Где взять чистую воду?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Почему сначала штифты?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_pins"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ты доверяешь креплениям Бранна?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что скажешь про рейдеров Обжига?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Что знаешь про Павшее солнце?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Есть что-нибудь от бликов?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^У меня кое-что из фургона «Седьмой».","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Пока.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Держу на ходу армейские грузовики. И чужие тоже, если привезут на мой верстак. Моторы, листы, крепления, что сломается, то и чиню. Что с грузовиком, понимаю по звуку, пока он заезжает.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Каждая деталь в чём-то хороша, а в чём-то подводит. Тяжёлый лист держит пули, но жрёт скорость. Большая пушка вдобавок жрёт место на платформе. Так что бери то, что нужно дороге, а не то, что блестит на полке. А если пушка у тебя на турели, первым делом смотри штифты. Турель — это кольцо, на котором пушка поворачивается над кузовом.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^На Свалке, порядком южнее отсюда. Бригады разбирают всё, что туда притащат, так что детали уходят почти даром. Придётся терпеть вонь горелого масла. За настоящим листом езжай к Павшему солнцу, там большой корпус в кратере. Говорю это сквозь зубы.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Зелёная яма, дальше за дорогой. Насосный пост вокруг старой цистерны: воду качают из скальных пород глубоко под землёй и продают канистрами. Вода чистая и недешёвая. Деньги бери с собой.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Потому что у копии, которую прикручивают у ворот, он один. Я видела, что бывает на крутом повороте с одним штифтом. Крепление съезжает, и пушка разворачивается прямо в твою кабину. Первую турель сделал Отто Бранн. Он поставил второй штифт. Он был прав, и я так и сказала командованию. Механика никто не спрашивает.","
","ev","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pins","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^С его клеймом — да. Он подписывает каждый шов. Шов, который можно прочесть, — это шов, которому можно верить. Я даже видела, как рейдеры из <term=kiln>Обжига</term> ездят с трофейными креплениями на своих грузовиках. Хорошей стали всё равно, чья она.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Рейдеры из лагеря на юге, и чинить грузовик, который они ободрали, мне бы не хотелось. Но старуха, что держит у них печь, Дагни Браск, переплавляет трофейные пушки в инструмент. Парочка у меня есть. Годные. Командованию не говори.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Лучший металл, какого касалась моя горелка, и худшее место, где его брать. Штабные зовут этот корпус боевым кораблём. Пусть покажут мне на нём хоть одно крепление под пушку. Нету. Там сплошные грузовые трюмы. А блики от стекла вокруг к полудню тебя ослепят.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Линзы из оплавленного стекла, тёмные, как дым. В плохие дни я ношу старую пару. Кто их продаёт сейчас, не знаю.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["

","^The <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term> is a pumphouse behind a wall of oil drums. It smells of hot iron and wet stone. Water trucks wait in a line at the loading bay.","
","^Every hose at the bay has a meter box on it, except one. A big grey tanker with a lantern painted on its door is filling from that one. It sits low on its springs already.","
","^A woman in a canvas apron stands at a row of dials and copies each number into a book.","
","^A man in a grey coat sits on a drum by the gate with a mug of tea. He watches the woman, not you.","
","ev","str","^perception","/str",{"x()":"skill","exArgs":1},2,">=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ His tea has gone cold, and he hasn't drunk any. He is listening to her. ",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_book","re":true},"^The big dial counts every barrel the pump brings up. Once a week Agnes writes its number down and sets it back to nothing, so the number is the week's whole total.","
","^You read her this week's number. She writes it in the book and your name beside it, then holds the book up so you can see the page. You've never had your name in a pump book before.","
","^Barrels a week; Pumped up, by the big dial; Bowl's trucks, by the hose meters; Passing trucks, by the hose meters; Household tanker, by its meter ","#","^head","/#","
","^Last spring; 410; 380; 10; 20 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Midsummer; 380; 340; 10; 30 ","#","^row","/#","
","^Autumn; 350; 290; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^This week; 300; 220; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every hose has a meter, and every truck that fills goes in by name. Your tank is in the passing column, under your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^The pump brings up less every season, and Bowl's trucks get less too. Until autumn the tanker's hose had a meter, and the columns added up to the barrel. Since the meter came off, the gap grows every week. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_leak","re":true},"^A leak that big would make the ground muddy. I check the tanks every day, and the ground is dry. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Nothing leaves here except through a hose. One hose has no meter. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev","str","^pipeBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_pipe","re":true},"^The <term=senate>Senate</term> ordered it. That tanker belongs to the Archon's household. The Archon heads the Senate, and his household lives on the top terrace of <term=bowl>Bowl</term>. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Now the tanker loads and goes, and I'm not allowed to write it down. Whatever the gap is, that's what it takes. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","

",{"->":"start.copy"},{"->":".^.^.^.27"},null]}],"nop","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_book","re":true},"^Большой счётчик считает каждую бочку, что поднимает насос. Раз в неделю Агнес записывает его цифру и сбрасывает счётчик в ноль, так что он показывает, сколько воды накачали за неделю.","

","^Бочек в неделю; Поднято, по большому счётчику; Грузовики Чаши, по водомерам; Проезжие грузовики, по водомерам; Цистерна двора, по её водомеру ","#","^head","/#","

","^Насос каждый сезон даёт меньше, и грузовикам Чаши достаётся меньше. До осени на шланге цистерны стоял водомер, и цифры по столбцам сходились до последней бочки. С тех пор как его сняли, разрыв растёт каждую неделю. ","#","^speaker: Агнес","/#","

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy: the pump brings up less every season, and the household's tanker takes more. Her guess, if that goes on: Bowl's trucks get almost nothing by next autumn.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy, last page: for Mirela, to compare with hers.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Steward Aurel Brede offered money to lose the copy and forget the dial.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Steward: half of the tanker's water fills a tank under the top terrace. It is the Senate's reserve for a dry year, and only the Archon may open it.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Top terrace: the household's tanker unloads into a stone tank. Its inlet has an empty flange where a meter used to sit.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Every barrel Agnes loaded onto Bowl's trucks reached Mirela's trough. The dial is the other half, and you read it.

","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"taken"},false,{"VAR=":"meter_taken"},false,{"VAR=":"knows_envelope"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_cover"},false,{"VAR=":"book_read"},false,{"VAR=":"offer_heard"},false,{"VAR=":"offer_open"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_water"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_steward"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_drain"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_secret"},false,{"VAR=":"asked_aim"},false,{"VAR=":"reserve_known"},false,{"VAR=":"canal_matches"},false,{"VAR=":"margin_read"},false,{"VAR=":"valve_read"},false,{"VAR=":"walked_out"},"str","^open","/str",{"VAR=":"sluice"},100,{"VAR=":"price"},60,{"VAR=":"fee"},40,{"VAR=":"fine"},50,{"VAR=":"toll"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес: насос с каждым сезоном даёт меньше, а цистерна двора берёт больше. Её прикидка, если так пойдёт: к будущей осени грузовикам Чаши почти ничего не достанется.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Копия Агнес, последняя страница: для Мирелы, сверить со своей.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Управляющий Аурел Бреде предложил денег, чтобы копия пропала, а счётчик забылся.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Управляющий: половина воды цистерны идёт в бак под верхней террасой. Это запас Сената на сухой год, открыть его может только Архонт.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Верхняя терраса: цистерна двора сливает в каменный бак. На его приёмном патрубке пустой фланец, где раньше стоял водомер.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Каждая бочка, которую Агнес налила грузовикам Чаши, дошла до жёлоба Мирелы. Счётчик — вторая половина, и вы его прочитали.

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Not much more to tell, and I'm short of daylight. Ask fast. ","#","^speaker: Driver ","/#","#","^reveal: char ","/#","#","^speed: fast","/#","
",{"->":".^.ask"},{"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","ev","str","^Is anyone still around the wagon?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What became of the crew?","/str","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is anything left on it?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Over and out.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Not that I saw. There were tracks all over the hollow, the wide kind raiders make with chains on their tires. They were old, though. Rain's come through since and washed the edges soft. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^They walked to Nose, the way I heard it. They were lucky. Whoever ran that wagon down wasn't out for prisoners. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
",["ev","str","^story-wagon-seven","/str",{"x()":"searched","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You tell me. Sounds like you got there first. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Could be. Raiders strip what they can lift, but an Army gun is heavy. I wouldn't have wanted to carry one out of that hollow. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Over and out. Keep to the high ground. The hollows hide more than they show. ","#","^speaker: Driver","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Больше почти нечего рассказать. До темноты времени мало. Спрашивай быстро. ","#","^speaker: Водитель ","/#","#","^reveal: char ","/#","#","^speed: fast","/#","
",{"->":".^.ask"},{"ask":[["#","^checkpoint: start.ask","/#","ev","str","^Вокруг фургона кто-нибудь остался?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Что стало с экипажем?","/str","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^На нём что-нибудь осталось?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Конец связи.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Я никого не видел. По лощине следы кругом, широкие, как у рейдеров с цепями на шинах. Старые, правда. Дождь с тех пор прошёл и края размыл. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Дошли до Носа, как я слышал. Повезло им. Тот, кто загнал фургон, пленных брать не собирался. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
",["ev","str","^story-wagon-seven","/str",{"x()":"searched","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Тебе виднее. Выходит, ты у фургона раньше меня. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Может. Рейдеры забирают, что унесут, а армейская пушка тяжёлая. Я бы такую из лощины тащить не взялся. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.3"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Конец связи. Держись высоких мест. Лощины прячут больше, чем показывают. ","#","^speaker: Водитель","/#","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^stat: money Money","/#","#","^fact: halves_fit Bench: Duvall's half of the pin and yours meet face to face, with no gap.","/#","#","^fact: report_seen Dispatch log: Corporal Teller's report says raiders ran wagon Seven down at the bend and the cannon went over the edge. Command wrote the wagon off.","/#","#","^fact: heard_duvall Duvall: the gun came loose on the bend and swung into the cab. Nobody shot at them. Teller tied the gun down, and they walked.","/#","#","^fact: offer_heard Yard: Corporal Teller offered money to drop the stub down the sump. His stripes pay his sister's ration card.","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Lena looks at your truck through the shed door before she looks at you. Then at your hand, closed round something. ","#","^place: Nose, the Army bench","/#","
","^A young soldier sits on a crate by the bench with his left arm in a sling, sorting bolts into a tin with his right.","
","ev","str","^Put the stub on the bench and say where it came from.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Put it back in your pocket and leave.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"halves_fit","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"bench"},null],"c-1":["
","^You leave her to her bolts. Behind you the soldier goes back to sorting, one-handed.","
","end",null]}],null],"bench":["#","^checkpoint: bench","/#","^You set the stub down and tell her: the dead Army wagon in the hollow below the bend in the Bowl north road, the gun swung back over the cab, and this, out of the gun's ring.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Lena holds the stub up to the light, and her face goes still.","
","^Bright, flat, no rust, no saw marks. Nobody cut that. It broke in one go, with the gun pulling on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Ilan. Come and look at this. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over. He takes a half pin from his shirt pocket and sets it face-down on yours. The broken faces meet with no gap between them.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the gunner on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The pin went on the bend, and the gun came round into the cab. That's how my arm went. I picked my half off the cab floor. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Lena looks it over once and puts it down.","
","^Somebody beat the face off this. I can't read a break that isn't there. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over and takes a half pin from his shirt pocket. He holds it beside yours. Its face is bright. Yours is a grey smear, and they don't meet.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the gunner on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.report"},{"report":["#","^checkpoint: bench.report","/#","^I fitted that swivel by order, with one pin. I wrote to command that it would kill somebody, and they filed it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Sergeant Kovac at dispatch logs every Army truck out and in. Here's his page for wagon Seven. I keep a copy, because my name's on the swivel. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^She pulls a creased sheet from under a tin of bolts and flattens it with her rag.","
","^Seven ; out ; cannon on swivel, one pin ","#","^head","/#","
","^Report ; Cpl Teller ; raiders at the bend, cannon torn off the wagon and lost over the edge ","#","^row","/#","
","^Margin ; Pvt Duvall ; pin sheared ","#","^row","/#","
","^Command ; by order ; wagon written off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Lost over the edge, it says. You took this stub out of the ring with the cannon still sitting on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^It's the first thing you've heard her say slowly.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ilan's half on its own is a bit of steel in a private's pocket. It could be off any truck. Yours came out of the ring on wagon Seven. Together they say this is the pin from wagon Seven, and your half stayed in the ring with the gun on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.46"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Give it to Kovac. Fixing the report is command's business, and command may never look. But a pin that snapped on the road is enough for Kovac to keep every truck with that mount in the yard. That much is his to do. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^With a clean face, I'd send you straight to Kovac. This one, he'd log as scrap, unless somebody saw the face before it was beaten. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],"nop","
","^You roll the stub under your thumb on the bench. An hour with a punch in a hot hollow, and it comes down to who gets to hold it.","
","^The yard door opens. A corporal comes in with sun-dark forearms and stripes on his sleeve. He looks at the soldier's half, then at yours, then at his watch.","
","^Corporal Teller. A word outside, driver. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.hub"},null],"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: bench.hub","/#","ev","str","^Send for Kovac and give him the stub.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Tell Lena what the face looked like before you ruined it.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^bent","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask Teller in front of Lena what happened on the bend. ","#","^check: social 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"||",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Take Teller back in and make him say it to Lena. ","#","^check: social 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==",{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"||",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Step outside with Teller.","/str",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Ask Duvall what happened on the bend.","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_duvall"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Take Teller's money.","/str",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Pocket the stub and leave.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},{"->":"bench.sign"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},"^You tell her: bright, one clean slant, no saw marks and no rust. She listens with her rag still in her hands.","
","^That's a pin that snapped on the road. Tell Kovac that, the way you told me. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":"bench.sign"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},{"->":"bench.admit"},null],"c-3":["
",{"->":"bench.admit"},null],"c-4":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"offer_heard","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},"^The yard is hot and smells of the wash pit. Teller stands where the shed wall hides him from the bench. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Look. I wrote that the cannon went over the edge. A wagon with no gun isn't worth a tow, so command wrote her off, and nobody drove out to look at the ring. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Command's order says one pin holds if you take the bends slow. So if the pin goes on a bend, the driver took it fast. I was driving. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^In Nose a corporal's family eats on his card. My sister draws her bread on my stripes. Lose them, and her card goes back to the clerk, and she's got a boy of her own. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Ilan says the pin broke. Lena says the pin broke. Kovac can't pull trucks off the road on a private's word or a mechanic's letter. A broken part out of the ring, he has to log as a fault. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^I'll pay you for it. It goes down the sump, and you never saw the hollow. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^He names a sum: ","ev",{"VAR?":"price"},"out","/ev","^ M. ","#","^reveal: all","/#","
","^He checks his watch while he waits. It's a good sum. You think about the sister, and then about the soldier's arm, and you can't make them weigh the same.","
","^He stays out in the yard to wait for your answer. You go back in to the bench.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_duvall","re":true},"^The soldier looks at the yard door before he answers.","
","^We came down onto the bend a bit fast. The gun went loose and came round, all at once, and the back of it hit the cab where I sat. The corporal pulled me out. Nobody shot at us. There wasn't anybody to shoot. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","^Teller tied the gun down so it wouldn't swing again, and we walked. He wrote raiders at the desk. I told Kovac it was the pin, and he put me in the margin. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
",{"->":"bench.sold"},null],"c-7":["
","^Teller watches you go all the way to your truck. Lena doesn't look up.","
","end",null]}],null],"sign":["ev","str","^logged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^Lena sends Duvall across the yard. He comes back with Sergeant Kovac, who has the log under his arm and reads the page standing up. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put the stub in his palm and tell him where it came from.","
","^Out of wagon Seven's ring, with the cannon still on her. I log it. Army steel brought in pays a finder's rate. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^He counts ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M onto the bench, then writes the stub in under Teller's report in the same ink. He doesn't strike the report out.","
","^The report is command's. Whether they read past the first line isn't mine to decide. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^Then he opens the depot list and draws a line through a pair of trucks that carry the same one-pin swivel. They stay off the road until Lena has looked at them.","
","^Teller goes out to the yard without a word. Duvall picks up his half of the pin and puts it back in his shirt pocket.","
","^If you drive down to Bowl, my mother buys her water at Hattie's well house. Tell her my arm's set. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","end",null],"admit":["ev",{"VAR?":"offer_heard"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You call Teller in from the yard. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put it to him in front of Lena, with the stub between you on the bench: out in the yard he told you he wrote "over the edge" so nobody would drive out and look at the ring.","
","^I said nothing in the yard. It was dusty, and they were shooting. It was raiders. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.5"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Teller is still waiting by the door for his word outside. You give it to him here instead. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put it to him in front of Lena, with the stub between you on the bench: his report says the cannon went over the edge, and you took this out of the ring with the cannon still sitting on it.","
","^Then I was wrong about the edge. It was dusty, and they were shooting. It was raiders. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.5"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You don't argue.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Then you ask him what the raiders shot with. You walked that hollow and found no casing in the grit and no bullet hole in the wagon.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","
","^You don't look at Teller. You look at Duvall, and so does Teller. The boy rubs the strap of his sling. When he speaks, he uses Teller's first name.","
","^Bram. You pulled me out of that cab. You were there when it came round. Say it. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","^Teller takes his hand off his watch. It's the soldier who breaks him, not you, and you're glad of it.","
","^The pin went on the bend, and the gun came round into the cab. I took the bend fast. I said raiders to keep my stripes. They pay my sister's ration card. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Teller says it again in front of him and signs it. Kovac writes it under the raid report and crosses nothing out.","
","^Corporal. Water cart, from tomorrow. Leave the stripes on my desk. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^And my sister's bread? ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^A water carter's card feeds one man. Rations aren't mine to give. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^Kovac holds out his hand for the stub. It's what you carried it up here for, and you give it to him. He counts out the finder's rate for it, ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M. Then he draws a line through a pair of depot trucks with the same swivel, off the road until Lena has looked at them.","
","ev","str","^admitted","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^If you drive down to Bowl, my mother buys her water at Hattie's well house. Tell her my arm's set. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You lean on it and tell him he lied in his report, that raiders don't leave a cannon behind. It comes out too fast and too loud, an accusation instead of a question. He hears that, and he steadies.","
","^I said it at the desk and I say it now. And this one was down in the hollow picking over Army property. Ask what else is in that truck. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Kovac comes and logs the stub as found, with your name as the finder and Teller's word beside it, and leaves the report standing above both.","
","^You'd have had a finder's rate for that. The Corporal says you stripped her, and that's one word against another. I don't pay out on those. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","ev","str","^logged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^He still draws a line through a pair of depot trucks with the same swivel. Teller goes out. Lena wipes her hands on her rag and looks at neither you nor Teller. You can't tell which of you she's angrier with.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null],"sold":["ev",{"VAR?":"price"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev","str","^buried","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^You go back out to the yard. Teller counts the money into your hand, note by note, and holds out his other hand for the stub. ","#","^page","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^bent","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^He doesn't look at its face. He doesn't know what he's looking for.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","
","^He walks it to the wash pit and drops it through the grate. You hear it hit water.","
","^When you go back past the shed, Lena is writing on a scrap of sign-out sheet and doesn't look up. Duvall is turning his half of the pin over in his fingers. Kovac's page still says the cannon went over the edge, and the trucks with the same mount still go out in the morning.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"halves_fit"},false,{"VAR=":"report_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"offer_heard"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_duvall"},60,{"VAR=":"price"},20,{"VAR=":"fee"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: halves_fit
facts.text: Bench: Duvall's half of the pin and yours meet face to face, with no gap.

facts.name: report_seen
facts.text: Dispatch log: Corporal Teller's report says raiders ran wagon Seven down at the bend and the cannon went over the edge. Command wrote the wagon off.

facts.name: heard_duvall
facts.text: Duvall: the gun came loose on the bend and swung into the cab. Nobody shot at them. Teller tied the gun down, and they walked.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Yard: Corporal Teller offered money to drop the stub down the sump. His stripes pay his sister's ration card.

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":[["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Лена смотрит на ваш грузовик через дверь мастерской, и только потом на вас. Потом на ваш кулак, в котором что-то зажато. ","#","^place: Нос, армейский верстак","/#","
","^У верстака на ящике сидит молодой солдат, левая рука на перевязи. Правой он перебирает болты и складывает их в банку.","
","ev","str","^Положить огрызок на верстак и сказать, откуда он.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Убрать в карман и уйти.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
